questions.prompt: How are the 10,000 work experiences scheduled?
questions.explanationZh: s3明确未来三年提供，不能把另一项每年岗位目标的时间单位移过来。

questions.prompt: What may count towards the entry-level jobs target?
options: Only jobs at newly established companies.
Only jobs completed during school visits.
New positions and existing vacancies filled by employers.
School lessons and competitions organised by employers.
questions.explanationZh: s6两类都包括：新设职位和被填补的现有空缺；体验活动或课程不是此处岗位。

questions.prompt: How does the plan connect education and employment?
options: It prioritises hiring experienced applicants over school-based preparation.
It combines school activities with workplace opportunities.
It counts school competitions towards the annual entry-level jobs target.
It makes the learning platform the main route into work placements.
questions.explanationZh: s7、s10、s11的学校学习与s15的职场体验形成衔接。正文没有优先录用有经验者，也未把学校比赛计入就业岗位目标，或说学习平台是工作体验的主要通道。

questions.prompt: What would be wrong with saying that one million students have already benefited?
options: The figure measures workplace experiences offered over three years.
The figure describes existing vacancies employers intend to fill.
The figure counts pupils attending disadvantaged schools alone.
The figure is a future reach target, not completed participation.
questions.explanationZh: s8目标期限2028年与s9直接区分目标和实际参与；不能把计划覆盖数写成已经受益数。
